rawFindings.title: Watched patterns now include non-watched globs when deciding which directories to add
rawFindings.explanation: `watchPatterns` now iterates every pattern object, only skipping those with `watched === false`, but the watcher still uses the full pattern list to derive watched directories. A config entry like `files: [{pattern: '/tmp/**', watched: false}, {pattern: '/src/**/*.js'}]` will still cause `/tmp` to be added if the unwatched pattern is more generic than the watched one. That makes chokidar observe files that the config explicitly marked as unwatched.
rawFindings.suggestion: Derive the watch list from only `patternObject.watched === true` entries before calling `watchPatterns`, or restore a watched-pattern filter inside `watchPatterns` and use it consistently for both directory selection and ignored-path checks.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With `files: [{pattern: '/tmp/**', watched: false}, {pattern: '/src/**/*.js'}]`, the watcher adds `/tmp` and emits events for changes under `/tmp`, even though those files are configured as not watched.

rawFindings.title: Excluded directories are no longer ignored before stat events, so excluded subtrees can still be observed
rawFindings.explanation: `createIgnore` now only checks glob matches against `excludes` and no longer short-circuits for directories or for paths that do not match any watched pattern. As a result, chokidar can descend into excluded directories and emit add/change/unlink events for files below them before the ignore predicate filters them, which reintroduces events for paths the watcher should never see.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep the previous directory/non-match guards in `createIgnore`, or pass both watched patterns and excludes so the predicate can ignore non-matching items and entire excluded directories up front.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With `files: ['/src/**/*.js']` and `exclude: ['/src/vendor/**']`, creating `/src/vendor/lib.js` can still trigger `add`/`change` events because the directory `/src/vendor` is not ignored early enough.
